heading: judo.sh Script
proposed: The frontend module list in judo.sh is built by a find pipe into xargs -0, which expects NUL-separated input but gets newlines, so several matching frontend pom.xml files can collapse into one entry. Workaround: build each frontend module by its path until judo.sh is fixed.
note: Impact on a multi-module frontend build not reproduced; the pipeline defect is clear from the line. checked in target/judo-ng-read/wt (pinned SHA), not re-checked on latest develop

heading: Available Fragment Extension Points
proposed: The root pom.xml of a generated project does not include the extra-dependency-management and extra-modules fragments, so a file with those names is silently ignored. Until the template wires them in, put the extra dependency with an explicit version in the app module extra-dependencies fragment.
evidence: target/judo-ng-read/wt/template__judo-esm-fullstack-project-template/judo-esm-fullstack-project-template-root/src/main/resources/pom.xml.hbs (includes listed at :8-671; extra-dependency-management and extra-modules absent). Input: judo-esm-fullstack-project-template@6273a87:pom.xml.hbs:72
note: Catalog lists both fragments as root pom extension points; the template does not include them. checked in target/judo-ng-read/wt (pinned SHA), not re-checked on latest develop

heading: `type` Package Reference > Behaviour Rules > NumericType Attribute Rules
proposed: Measured types whose values are not integers fall through a duplicated isInteger() branch in the generator and come out as java.lang.Object in the generated Java API. Until fixed, use a decimal attribute for values that need a Java numeric type.
note: Same defect in four generators (R0598, R0514, R0213, R1399) and the spec claim R0209. Not re-checked on latest develop.

heading: SDK Generator Template Parameters
proposed: An empty apiPrefix makes the default API package start with a dot, which is not a valid Java package. Set apiPrefix to a non-empty value when generating the REST API module.
note: Not re-checked on latest develop.

heading: SDK Generator Template Parameters
proposed: Same defect as R2209: a non-empty apiPrefix is mangled into slashes by an unescaped regex dot. Keep apiPrefix empty until fixed.
note: Duplicate of R2209 in the jaxrs generator.

heading: SDK Generator Template Parameters
proposed: A non-empty apiPrefix is turned into a file path with replaceAll(".", "/"), where the dot is a regex wildcard. The whole prefix becomes slashes, so generated API files go to a wrong path. Keep apiPrefix empty until fixed.
note: Same defect appears in the SDK and restassured generators (see R0513, R0713, R1400).

heading: REST Wire Contract
proposed: Relations whose target is a range input should use the <Name>RangeRequest type. The generated jaxrs RelationHelper gives these targets the <Name>CreateRequest type instead, because its first branch catches every non-query-customizer target. Use the range request type by hand in REST clients until fixed.
note: Not re-checked on latest develop.

heading: OpenAPI / Swagger Documentation
proposed: In generated DTOs for relations, the OpenAPI @Schema name is built from the wrong element, so the documented property name can differ from the Java getter name. Until fixed, take the property name from the generated getter, not from the Swagger UI.
note: Fact text cut in the input; the claim is the only evidence. Not re-checked on latest develop.

heading: Response Metadata and Wire Conversion
proposed: Generated response DTOs declare the __deleteable and __updateable setters with a primitive boolean, while their fields and getters are Boolean. Passing a null Boolean to these setters fails with a NullPointerException at unboxing. Pass an explicit true or false.
note: Not re-checked on latest develop.
